assumptions: Four synthetic 1 ha catchments, each 80% impervious; areas do not imply surveyed catchment boundaries.
Surface routing uses the SWMM nonlinear reservoir with synthetic width, slope, roughness and depression storage; infiltration uses assumed Horton parameters.
T1 clean scenario routes all catchment runoff directly to its associated sewer node, with no independent inlet capture limit. Finite inlet restriction is not yet implemented (T3).
Flooding is lost from the 1D network (ALLOW_PONDING=NO); no surface flood depth, extent, return flow or 2D coupling is computed.
Outfall stage is fixed at invert plus the selected assumed tailwater depth; no observed river hydrograph is available.
One-hour rain is followed by one-hour dry drainage; the full simulation window is included in metrics.
